只靠一只斜槽和一块挡板，能不能把平抛拆成两个分运动、量出初速度？: With only an inclined chute and a catch board, can you split a horizontal launch into two component motions and measure the initial speed?

两球同时落地 ⟹ 竖直分运动是自由落体；等时点的 y 比 1 : 4 : 9 :: Both balls land together ⟹ the vertical component is free fall; y at equal times is in the ratio 1 : 4 : 9 : 16
由 y = ½gt² 反推「相等的时间间隔」T = 0.0639 s——桌上没有: Work back from y = ½gt² to the "equal time interval" T = 0.0639 s; there's no timer on the bench
相等时间内 x 比 1 : 2 : 3 : 4、Δx 恒定 ⟹ 水平分运动是匀速: In equal times x is in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3 : 4 and Δx is constant ⟹ the horizontal component is uniform motion

末端水平的斜槽、三条释放刻线、钢球: Chute with a horizontal end, three release marks, steel ball
小锤、弹性金属片、A/B 两球、两个接球座: Small hammer, spring metal strip, balls A/B, two catch cups
背板、白纸与复写纸、可上下调节的倾斜挡板: Backboard, white paper and carbon paper, an adjustable sloped catch board
立着的方格纸板与频闪照片对照卡: Upright grid-paper board and a strobe photo reference card
桌上这些器材各干什么？教材给了哪两个方案？为什么这里根本没有秒表？: What is each piece of equipment on the bench for? Which two methods does the textbook give? Why is there no stopwatch here at all?
拖视角绕实验台看一圈：顺「释放刻线 → 槽口 → 钢球 → 白纸上的印迹 → 挡: Drag the view around the bench and follow "release mark → chute exit → ball → marks on the paper → catch board → grid paper"
默认工况（刻线②、挡板第 2 档 80 mm、末端水平、理想器材）：v₀ = 1: Default setup (mark ②, catch board position 2 at 80 mm, end horizontal, ideal equipment): v₀ = 1.50 m/s (calculated from the landing point, not written on the mark), landing x = 191.66 mm, Δx = 95.83 mm, T = 0.0639 s; the angle sign reads "end horizontal" and the strobe card shows a row of equally timed white balls.
教材 p.10 的方案一（频闪照片或录像，一次拍全所有等时位置）与方案二（斜槽描: Textbook p.10's method 1 (strobe photo or video, capturing all equally timed positions at once) and method 2 (tracing with a chute, one point at a time) give the same trajectory; this lesson follows the reference case (vertical first in Fig. 5.3-2 on p.11, then horizontal in Fig. 5.3-3 on p.12). There's no timer anywhere in the lesson: the time interval has to come from the law of vertical motion.
器材分四组认：斜槽与钢球 / 竖直比对 / 描迹背板与挡板 / 方格纸与频闪卡。: Recognize the equipment in four groups: chute and ball / vertical comparison / tracing board and catch board / grid paper and strobe card.
两个方案的区别只在「记录方式」：一个一次拍全等时位置，一个一次只描一个点。: The two methods differ only in "how they record": one captures all equally timed positions at once, the other traces one point at a time.
三个量各有各的来源：v₀ 由落点算、T 由竖直规律算、k 由四点拟合——没有一个: Each quantity has its own source: v₀ from the landing point, T from the vertical law, k from fitting four points. Not a single time is measured.
去掉这一步：学生不知道桌上这些东西谁负责什么，后面每一步都会问「这个数哪来的」。: Skip this step and students don't know what each item does, and every later step prompts "where did this number come from?".
器材辨认是必做实验第一项能力（课标 p.17「会使用所提供的实验器材进行实验并获: Identifying equipment is the first skill of a required experiment (curriculum standard p.17: "use the equipment provided to carry out experiments and obtain data").
刻线② · v₀ 1.50 m/s · 挡板 80 mm: Mark ② · v₀ 1.50 m/s · board 80 mm
小锤敲下去，A 球平抛、B 球自由下落——谁先落地？换个落台高度、换个击打力度，: The hammer strikes: ball A is launched horizontally, ball B drops freely. Which lands first? Does the answer change with a different drop height or a harder strike?
在 3D 里点一下小锤（或按「下一步」自动敲一次），看 A、B 两球谁先落到接球: Tap the hammer in 3D (or press "Next" to strike once automatically) and see which of balls A and B reaches its catch cup first
敲一次：两球同时落地（只听到一次落地声）——都从台面上方 0.36 m 落下，t: One strike: both balls land together (you hear a single landing sound). Both fall 0.36 m from above the bench, t = √(2×0.36/9.8) = 0.2711 s, and their landing times differ by 0. Change the drop height (0.20 m → t = 0.2020 s) or the strike strength (v₀ changes) and they still land together; ball A just lands farther away. Watching the video in exercise 3 on textbook p.13: table height 0.80 m → t = 0.4041 s, about 10 frames at 25 fps, and the two balls are at the same height in every frame.
竖直分运动就是自由落体（初速为零、加速度 g），与水平初速度无关。教材 p.12: The vertical component is free fall (zero initial speed, acceleration g), independent of horizontal initial speed. Textbook p.12 only asks "From this experiment, what kind of motion is the vertical component of projectile motion?" without answering; the answer is inferred from "both balls land together" in Fig. 5.3-2 on p.11.
facts A2.2、A2.7、A2.17；图5.3-2（p.11）；B2.1: facts A2.2, A2.7, A2.17; Fig. 5.3-2 (p.11); B2.1 item 15; standard values table E
竖直分运动与水平初速度无关：换落台高度、换击打力度，两球仍然同时落地。: The vertical component doesn't depend on horizontal speed: change the drop height or strike strength, and the balls still land together.
是「两球同时落地」这一件事把竖直方向的规律钉死成自由落体。: It's the single fact "both balls land together" that pins the vertical motion down as free fall.
教材用问句收尾（p.12），答案要学生自己从现象里说出来。: The textbook ends with a question (p.12); students have to state the answer from what they observe.
去掉这一步：后面「1 : 4 : 9 : 16」就只是背下来的一个比，学生不知道: Skip this step and the later "1 : 4 : 9 : 16" is just a memorized ratio, with no reason behind it.
必考：平抛竖直分运动的性质（课标 p.17「通过对数据的分析发现其中的特点」）。: Exam must-know: the nature of the vertical component of horizontal projectile motion (curriculum standard p.17: "find patterns by analyzing data").
教材为什么专门写一句「斜槽 M 末端水平」？不水平的话，第一个坏掉的是什么？: Why does the textbook specifically say "the end of chute M is horizontal"? If it isn't, what breaks first?
进这一步时斜槽末端是翘的：把它调平，再看一眼翘着时钢球会怎样: The chute's end is tilted up when you enter this step: level it, and look at what the ball does while it's tilted
进来时斜槽末端是翘的（倾角牌写「末端上翘 3.0°」）。末端水平时把钢球放在槽口: You start with the chute end tilted up (the angle sign reads "end tilted up 3.0°"). With the end horizontal, a ball placed at the exit and released stays put; tilted up 3° it rolls back into the chute on its own, at a = g·sin3° = 0.5129 m/s². With the tilt, step 8 will show the v₀ from the four positions dropping from 1.70 to 1.55 (true value 1.50), with an x ratio of 1 : 1.88 : 2.76 : 3.64.
「末端水平」不是形式要求：只有初速度只有水平分量，竖直方向才是「初速为零的自由落: "End horizontal" isn't a formality: only if the initial velocity is purely horizontal is the vertical motion "free fall from rest", and only then does step 5's "1 : 4 : 9 : 16" hold. This is the lesson's "wrong procedure → visible consequence → explain it".
facts A2.12、A2.14、A4.2；图5.3-3（p.12）；B2.1: facts A2.12, A2.14, A4.2; Fig. 5.3-3 (p.12); B2.1 items 4, 12; standard values table B
末端水平就是「v₀ 只有水平分量」；检验办法：把球放在槽口松手，球不动。: End horizontal means "v₀ is purely horizontal"; to check, place the ball at the exit and let go: it shouldn't move.
上翘 3° 时球自己滚回槽里（a = 0.5129 m/s²），而学生从纸面上看: Tilted up 3°, the ball rolls back into the chute on its own (a = 0.5129 m/s²), and students can't see that from the paper; that's why the textbook spells it out.
它是后面所有「等时」结论的前提，第 8 步还要用它解释偏差。: It's the premise of every later "equal time" conclusion, and step 8 uses it to explain deviations.
去掉这一步：学生按「平抛」算一条其实是斜抛的轨迹，图线不对也说不清为什么。: Skip this step and students treat what's really an angled launch as horizontal, and can't say why the graph is off.
必考：装置的调节要求（A7.1；教材 p.12 原句）。: Exam must-know: how the apparatus must be adjusted (A7.1; textbook p.12 wording).
挡板从 20 mm 升到 320 mm，白纸上会留下四个点。这四个高度为什么正好: Raise the catch board from 20 mm to 320 mm and four marks appear on the paper. Why exactly these four heights?
挡板从第 1 档升到第 4 档，每个档位按「记录一组」存一行，记满 4 行: Raise the catch board from position 1 to position 4, pressing "Record" at each to save a row, until you have 4 rows
默认 v₀ = 1.50 m/s，四个落点 (y, x) = (20, 95.8: Default v₀ = 1.50 m/s; the four landing points (y, x) = (20, 95.83) / (80, 191.66) / (180, 287.49) / (320, 383.33) mm; the four y values are in the ratio 1 : 4 : 9 : 16; four marks appear on the paper and the record table has four rows.
挡板高度取 1 : 4 : 9 : 16 是为了下一步能定出相等的时间间隔（t: Board heights in the ratio 1 : 4 : 9 : 16 let the next step fix equal time intervals (t ratio = 1 : 2 : 3 : 4); the four points on the paper are the first half of the textbook's "connect the marks with a smooth curve".
facts A2.18、A2.19、A4.4、A4.5；图5.3-3（p.12）: facts A2.18, A2.19, A4.4, A4.5; Fig. 5.3-3 (p.12), Fig. 5.3-7 (p.13); B2.1 items 2, 14; standard values tables A, F
四个挡板高度取 1 : 4 : 9 : 16 不是随便定的，是为了让时间比正好: The four board heights in the ratio 1 : 4 : 9 : 16 aren't arbitrary; they make the time ratio exactly 1 : 2 : 3 : 4.
白纸 + 复写纸记的是球的下缘（这条第 8 步要用）。: White paper + carbon paper record the bottom edge of the ball (step 8 needs this).
同一条刻线内四次落点必须同一个 v₀，换刻线才是换 v₀。: All four landings for one mark must share the same v₀; changing the mark changes v₀.
去掉这一步：学生没有数据，「用平滑曲线把印迹连起来」也无从做起。: Skip this step and students have no data, so "connect the marks with a smooth curve" can't be done.
必考：描迹法的操作（教材 p.12）；记录表是必做实验的产出。: Exam must-know: the tracing procedure (textbook p.12); the record table is the product of a required experiment.
桌上没有计时器。怎么知道钢球落到这四个高度分别用了多长时间？: There's no timer on the bench. How do you know how long the ball took to fall to each of these four heights?
盯住方格纸上的四个点与竖直方向的 y₁ : y₂ : y₃ : y₄ 尺寸线: Watch the four points on the grid paper and the vertical y₁ : y₂ : y₃ : y₄ dimension lines
y 的比 1 : 4 : 9 : 16 ⟹ t 的比 1 : 2 : 3 : 4: y ratio 1 : 4 : 9 : 16 ⟹ t ratio 1 : 2 : 3 : 4 (y = ½gt²); position 1 fixes the equal interval T = √(2×20 mm / 9.8) = 0.0639 s, and the four landing times are 0.0639 / 0.1278 / 0.1917 / 0.2556 s. This T is calculated, not measured.
「相等的时间间隔」是靠竖直分运动是自由落体这条结论反推出来的（教材 p.12 原: The "equal time interval" is worked back from the conclusion that the vertical component is free fall (textbook p.12: "find a way to fix 'equal time intervals'"), so the whole lesson needs no timer.
facts A2.7、A2.19、A4.7；图5.3-3（p.12）、图5.3-: facts A2.7, A2.19, A4.7; Fig. 5.3-3 (p.12), Fig. 5.3-1 (p.10); B2.1 item 7; standard values table F
没有计时器也能有「相等的时间间隔」：全靠 y = ½gt² 反推。: You can have "equal time intervals" without a timer: it all comes from working back from y = ½gt².
y 比 1:4:9:16 ⟹ t 比 1:2:3:4，第 1 档一下就把 T 定: y ratio 1:4:9:16 ⟹ t ratio 1:2:3:4, and position 1 fixes T at once.
T = 0.0639 s 与装置尺度自洽：四段飞行一共 0.2556 s。: T = 0.0639 s is consistent with the apparatus size: the four flights total 0.2556 s.
去掉这一步：v₀ = Δx/T 里的 T 就没有出处，学生只能瞎猜。: Skip this step and the T in v₀ = Δx/T has no source, leaving students to guess.
必考：由竖直方向定时间间隔（教材 p.12；与 p.13 练习第 3 题同一个思: Exam must-know: fixing the time interval from vertical motion (textbook p.12; the same idea as exercise 3 on p.13).
时间间隔既然相等了，看水平位移——它每次都一样吗？换个画法能看得更清楚吗？: Now that the time intervals are equal, look at the horizontal displacement. Is it the same each time? Would a different plot show it more clearly?
把方格纸切成「检验」图：横轴换成挡板档位序号，四点应落在一条过原点的直线上: Switch the grid paper to the "check" plot: the x-axis becomes the board position number, and the four points should lie on a line through the origin
The four landing points have horizontal displacements of 95.83 / 191.66 / 287.49 / 383.33 mm, in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3 : 4; the step Δx = 95.83 mm is constant (all three intervals identical) ⟹ the horizontal component is uniform motion; v₀ = Δx / T = 95.83 mm / 0.0639 s = 1.50 m/s. On the check plot the four points lie on a line through the origin.
相等时间内水平位移相等 ⟹ 水平分速度不变（教材 p.12「再看相等的时间内水平: Equal horizontal displacements in equal times ⟹ constant horizontal velocity (textbook p.12: "then look at the horizontal displacement in equal times"). No vertical fault can change the horizontal conclusion: with the end tilted up, Δx is still 95.33 / 95.58 / 95.64 mm; what breaks is only "whether these points are equally timed".
facts A2.3、A2.16、A4.7；图5.3-3（p.12）、图5.3-: facts A2.3, A2.16, A4.7; Fig. 5.3-3 (p.12), Fig. 5.3-8 (p.13); B2.1 items 5, 6, 9; standard values tables A, B
Δx 恒定才叫匀速（三个间隔必须一样），不是「看着差不多」。: Uniform means Δx is constant (all three intervals the same), not "looks about equal".
换画法（横轴档位序号）四点要落在过原点的直线上，这才排除「有初位移」。: On the alternative plot (x-axis = position number) the four points must lie on a line through the origin; that rules out "an initial offset".
水平方向的结论不受竖直方向毛病影响：上翘时 Δx 仍恒定。: The horizontal conclusion isn't affected by vertical faults: with the end tilted up, Δx is still constant.
去掉这一步：v₀ 只是 Δx/T 算出来的一个数，学生没有「水平是匀速」的证据。: Skip this step and v₀ is just a number from Δx/T, with no evidence that "horizontal motion is uniform".
必考：由等时位移判断分运动性质（A7.3）、v₀ = Δx/T。: Exam must-know: judging the type of component motion from displacements in equal times (A7.3), v₀ = Δx/T.
Δx 95.83 mm · v₀ 1.50 m/s · x 比 1:2:3:4: Δx 95.83 mm · v₀ 1.50 m/s · x ratio 1:2:3:4
把刻线从②换成③，还是这四个挡板档位——四点往哪边跑？连起来的曲线变陡还是变平？: Switch from mark ② to mark ③ with the same four board positions. Which way do the four points move? Does the curve get steeper or flatter?
刻线换成③重新做一遍：四个挡板档位各记一行，看抛物线变成什么样: Redo it with mark ③: record a row at each of the four board positions and see how the parabola changes
刻线③：v₀ 由 1.50 升到 2.00 m/s，四点变成 127.78 /: Mark ③: v₀ rises from 1.50 to 2.00 m/s, and the four points become 127.78 / 255.55 / 383.33 / 511.10 mm (still 1 : 2 : 3 : 4); the trajectory coefficient k = y/x² drops from 2.1778 to 1.2250 m⁻¹ (theory k = g/(2v₀²)), so the curve flattens; mark ① (v₀ = 1.00, k = 4.9000) is steeper. For each of the three marks, the four points fall on one curve through the origin ⟹ the trajectory is a parabola.
换 v₀ 只把抛物线整体变陡 / 变平，形状仍是 y = kx²（教材 p.16: Changing v₀ only makes the whole parabola steeper / flatter; the shape stays y = kx² (textbook p.16, eq. (3), Sec. 4). A constant k is the quantitative way of saying "one parabola", and v₀ = √(g/(2k)) is a second measuring route that must agree with the single-point method in item 5.
facts A2.5、A2.6、A2.9、A7.9；图5.3-8（p.13）、p: facts A2.5, A2.6, A2.9, A7.9; Fig. 5.3-8 (p.13), p.16 eq. (3); B2.1 items 8, 10, 11; standard values tables A, G
换 v₀ 只改抛物线的陡缓，不改「是抛物线」这件事：k 从 2.1778 → 1: Changing v₀ only changes how steep the parabola is, not that it is one: k goes 2.1778 → 1.2250 → 4.9000.
轨迹方程 y = (g/2v₀²)x² 是第 4 节的内容，本节只要求「看出是同: The trajectory equation y = (g/2v₀²)x² belongs to Sec. 4; this section only asks you to "see that it's the same curve".
由 k 也能反解 v₀，与单点算法必须一致——两条路互相校核。: v₀ can also be found from k, and it must agree with the single-point method: the two routes check each other.
去掉这一步：学生会以为「抛物线」是一句形容词，不知道它的系数只由 v₀ 决定。: Skip this step and students think "parabola" is just a descriptive word, not knowing its coefficient depends only on v₀.
必考：平抛轨迹方程与 v₀ 的关系（教材 p.16 式(3)）。: Exam must-know: how the projectile trajectory equation relates to v₀ (textbook p.16, eq. (3)).
如果末端翘了一点，或者忘了钢球有半径，四个点还能算出一个 v₀ 吗？偏大还是偏小: If the end is tilted up slightly, or you forget the ball has a radius, can the four points still give one v₀? Too high or too low?
先把「理想器材」拨到真实看一遍，再把「斜槽末端」拨到上翘看第二遍，最后两个一起开: First switch "Ideal equipment" to real and look, then switch "Chute end" to tilted up and look again, then turn both on together

两种毛病都是系统性偏大，区别在「随档位怎么变」：球半径让越靠上偏得越多（v₀测/: Both faults give systematically high values; they differ in "how it changes across positions": the ball radius biases the upper positions more (v₀_meas/v₀ − 1 = √(1 + r/y) − 1), while an upward tilt biases every position and the x ratio is no longer 1:2:3:4. 教材把这两件事都写成了问句（p.11「物体的大小对描绘轨迹是否有影响？如何减小这: The textbook poses both as questions (p.11: "Does the size of the object affect the traced trajectory? How can the effect be reduced?"), and students supply the answers.
去掉这一步：学生会把「四个档位算出四个 v₀」当成自己算错，不知道那是装置的账。: Skip this step and students think "four positions giving four v₀ values" means they made a mistake, not seeing it's the apparatus's doing.
实验素养：说出误差来源与方向（课标 p.17「尝试对其作出解释」；A7.5、A7: Lab skills: state error sources and their direction (curriculum standard p.17: "try to explain them"; A7.5, A7.6).
给你斜槽、白纸、挡板和方格纸，不许用秒表——能不能把钢球的初速度测出来，让四组数: Given a chute, white paper, a catch board and grid paper, and no stopwatch, can you measure the ball's initial speed and let four data sets show it's consistent?
记满 4 组、四个挡板档都记、同一条刻线，让四组 v₀ 的极差不超过 3 %: Record 4 sets, one at each board position, all with the same release mark, so the spread of the four v₀ values is at most 3 %
达标条件：① 记满 4 组、四个挡板档位都记；② 四组都在同一条刻线下记；③ 四: Pass conditions: ① 4 sets recorded, all four board positions covered; ② all four recorded with the same release mark; ③ the spread / mean of the four v₀ values ≤ 3 %. One valid solution: mark ②, end horizontal, ideal equipment, four positions → v₀ = 1.50 / 1.50 / 1.50 / 1.50, spread 0 %. Counterexamples: end tilted up, spread 9.49 %; ball radius not corrected, 19.39 %; both together, 27.03 %. None of these pass.

真实档（球半径未修正）一定测不准——这不是学生算错，是球半径那一项的系统误差。: Real mode (ball radius not corrected) will always miss: that isn't a calculation mistake, it's the systematic error from the ball radius.

末端上翘 3°：钢球多了一个向上的初速度，竖直方向不再是自由落体。: End tilted up 3°: the ball gets an upward initial velocity, so the vertical motion is no longer free fall.
真实器材：白纸上记的是球的下缘，球心比它高一个半径。: Real equipment: the paper records the ball's bottom edge, and the center is one radius higher.
理想器材：球心正对挡板、读数连续（教材的理想情况）。: Ideal equipment: the ball's center lines up with the board and readings are continuous (the textbook's ideal case).

相等时间间隔内测得的水平位移都相等，说明水平分运动是: The horizontal displacements measured in equal time intervals are all equal, showing the horizontal component is

相等时间内位移相等 ⟹ 水平分速度不变 ⟹ 匀速直线运动（教材 p.12）。也正: Equal displacements in equal times ⟹ constant horizontal velocity ⟹ uniform motion (textbook p.12). That's also why v₀ = Δx/T.

白纸上记的是球的下缘，球心比它高一个半径 r：y 读小了 r，由 v₀ = x√: The paper records the ball's bottom edge, and its center is one radius r higher, so y is read short by r; the v₀ from v₀ = x√(g/2y) is always too high, and the larger r/y (the higher landing points), the bigger the bias (facts A2.15).
用一只斜槽、一块挡板和白纸上的几个印迹，把平抛拆成水平与竖直两个分运动，量出钢球: Use a chute, a catch board and a few marks on white paper to split a horizontal launch into horizontal and vertical components, measure the ball's initial speed, and say which way two faults push the result.
